## Key features

### ✅ Designed for autonomy

- **Easy Reading**: short sentences, everyday vocabulary, one idea per screen.
- **No pressure**: no timers, no negative scores, no punishment.
- **Positive reinforcement**: friendly sounds and animations celebrate correct answers.
- **<If catalogue**: progressive stars only ever added, never subtracted.>

### ✅ Accessible to everyone

- **Large buttons**: minimum 64×64 pixels.
- **Large text**: clear readable font (Atkinson Hyperlegible).
- **High contrast**: light colours on a white background.
- **Audio only where it adds value**: a 🔊 button appears only when the activity design requires it.

### ✅ Privacy by default

No accounts, no cookies, no analytics, no third-party runtime. All
your data lives in `localStorage` on your own device. You can
clear it at any time from the **Settings** route (or the browser's
site-data controls).

### ✅ In two languages

- 🇪🇸 **Español** (default)
- 🇬🇧 **English** (can be changed from the menu)
